text:
𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝟭𝟮𝟭, 𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗪𝗜𝗡! 🏏🔥

Tom Banton hit 121 off 99 as England made 355/6 in Adelaide.
Atkinson took 4/28; Australia 220 all out. Won by 135, series 1-1.

Decider in Hobart 👀

#AUSvENG #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗞, 𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗞𝗜 𝗕𝗜𝗚 𝗪𝗜𝗡! 🏏🔥

👉 Adelaide 2nd ODI mein England ne Australia ko 135 run se haraya
👉 Tom Banton: 121 (99 gend), 10 chauke aur 4 chhakke
👉 England 355/6, Australia 220 all out
👉 Gus Atkinson ke 4/28, series 1-1

Hobart mein decider! Kaun jeetega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AUSvENG #ODI
